notes.title: Bug fixes reported by players:
notes.notes:
Bug fixes reported by players:
Fixed the ownership and color matching of the large plot of land
The achievement system has become simpler
Modify some experiences
Fixed the issue where clicking on the item bar caused the game to be unable to proceed
The possibility that some games cannot be played
Fix bugs that have a certain probability of not being able to replay

notes.title: Bug fixes, game content updates
notes.notes:
Optimized 3D calculations for maps
Make the game run more smoothly
Switching maps no longer causes lag and jumps out

Fixed the issue of occasional game crashes caused by duplicate saves

Occasionally, there may be situations where AI players are unable to play the game, but we have not found any such situations through our local testing~
But if such a situation exists, please contact us in a timely manner, inform us of the specific situation, and help us quickly locate it, so that we can repair it as quickly as possible
(Within one day)

If 1000 players request to add a game progress save function
We will add it in future game updates~

Finally, thank you all for your attention

notes.title: After victory, the replay button shows a time change, adding 2 mini games BUGFIX
notes.notes:
The appearance time of the replay button after victory has been updated from around 10 seconds to around 3 seconds
Add 2 mini games: 1. Balloon Shooting 2. Airplane Treasure Hunt

Adjusted some in-game settings values
Optimized game memory and CPU management
Fixed some bugs and updated some user experience
Fix the behavior of AI girls using unethical methods to deceive players' money
Bug where players cannot exit after entering the game
Already fixed
Now you can enter the options
 clicked the exit button

notes.title: Major update~The bug that cannot be unlocked in the H story has now been fixed
notes.notes:
Sorry, friends who have installed DLC (hPatch)!
Our carefully crafted 21 H stories cannot be unlocked through game victories in the past 2 days!
We deeply apologize!

But now we have fixed this bug~
You can now unlock the H scene by winning the game (with Happy Boom free DLC required)!

Finally, infinite gratitude and appreciation! We will continue to work hard~

notes.title: Patch - Hot:
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where you could not exit and re-play on other maps
Fixed an issue where scenes could not be saved after switching
Fixed an issue in the gallery where the character BOOM Portrait could be unlocked at will
(As part of the compensation for the old save, some characters can unlock BOOM status directly)
UI adaptation causes a CPU100% problem
Fixed Some BUGS
PS.
Turning off Steam's shader pre-caching feature can make the game start in seconds, instantly solving the problem of slow game opening
